annotations.title: List requests received by a webhook URL

description: Lists the requests a webhook URL from create_webhook_url has received, oldest first, with method, path, query, headers and body (long bodies shortened; get_webhook_request has them in full). Pass after_id = the last id you have seen to get only newer requests; the answer ends with the id to use next time. Set wait_seconds (up to 10) to wait briefly for a request to arrive, e.g. right after triggering the sender; for longer waits call it again rather than waiting in one call.

after_id.description: Only requests with a higher id than this. Default 0: from the oldest kept request.

bin.description: The bin id from create_webhook_url (e.g. abc123def456). Its capture URL or private bin page URL also work.

key.description: The bin's secret key from create_webhook_url. Not needed if "bin" is the private bin page URL, which contains it.

wait_seconds.description: If nothing newer has arrived yet, wait up to this many seconds for it. Default 0 (answer at once).

name: list_webhook_requests
